name: Gasthof Kienbergklamm
beschreibung: The Gasthof Kienbergklamm is located on the outskirts of Kufstein in Tirol. The Kienbergklamm and the surrounding mountains shape the immediate surroundings. The house offers a traditional atmosphere with regional cuisine. Guests can expect simple but well-kept room furnishings. The amenities include a restaurant serving Tiroler Küche and an outdoor dining garden. Hiking trails start right outside the door and invite you to take excursions. The town center of Kufstein can be reached by car in just a few minutes.
